rationale: Independent reading before the producer rationale: held EO 11105 (28 FR 3909, Apr. 18, 1963) transfers AEC Atomic Energy Community Act functions for Los Alamos to the HHFA Administrator (secs. 1-6), amends EO 9816 to the extent inconsistent (sec. 7), has a validity/no-challenge clause (sec. 8) and adds a Los Alamos exclusion to EO 10657 (sec. 9); no own term. Held EO 12553 (51 FR 7237, Feb. 25, 1986): 'the following Executive Orders, and any amendments thereto, are revoked', and the table (51 FR 7242) lists '11105 Transferring to the Housing and Home Finance Administrator certain functions of the Atomic Energy Commission under the Atomic Energy Community Act of 1955' by number. Whole-order revocation, no exception or savings clause; my independent status NO agrees. Refutation attempts: right instrument and number (confirmed in held table text, not only via the machine 'via EO 10657' ACT inference); not a partial supersession. D6: history events are only the two EO 12553 revocation leads; a corpus search of held texts for EO 11105 by number finds no other naming order, so no amendment, revival or extension before or after 1986 was removed or ignored; no earlier own-term end. Accept.
